latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Internship — an AI-powered video editing assistant for building your portfolio.

- Upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe edits; get polished results in 1–2 minutes.
- Automated authentication with 100 free credits; minimal setup needed.
- Supports actions like trimming pauses, adding lower-third titles, previewing timeline, and exporting in common formats (MP4, MOV, etc).
- Seamless cloud GPU processing; no local install required.
- User prompts intelligently routed to upload, export, status, credits, and editing actions.
- Clear error handling for common issues (invalid token, unsupported file, credits, etc).
